verdict.rationale: The only documented update path is for Antigravity: "Reinstall with the same command to update" (gh-8). That is a re-run of the install command rather than a dedicated update command. Superpowers is distributed through the Claude Code plugin marketplace (docs-36, docs-51) and native harness install mechanisms (docs-48), but none of the evidence says the marketplace auto-updates it. Installation is also per-harness (gh-5), so the update story likely differs by harness and is undocumented outside Antigravity. Missing for 10: an explicit update command or documented marketplace auto-update, update instructions for Claude Code, Codex and the other harnesses, and independent confirmation that updates apply cleanly without a fresh install.
